what_is.heading: What Are Sheckles in Grow a Garden 2?
paragraphs: Sheckles are the main currency in Grow a Garden 2, which came out on Roblox on June 12, 2026. You spend them on seeds, gear, props and pets around the map.
You earn Sheckles by selling crops and pets at the Sell Stand. Each friend in your server adds a 10% Sheckle boost, up to 70%. Leaves are a second currency from the Fall Harvest world.

official_prices.heading: Sheckle Prices: Robux Store vs DropMarket
official_prices.note: Grow a Garden 2 sells Sheckles for Robux in its Store, at 500 Sheckles per Robux. There's no direct cash price, so the real cost depends on how you buy your Robux.

extras.label: Leaves
extras.detail: Same pack sizes and Robux prices as Sheckles

extras.label: Gift packs
extras.detail: Every pack has a gift version, so someone else can buy it for you

delivery.heading: How Grow a Garden 2 Delivery Works
steps: After checkout, send your Roblox username (the @ name) in the order chat.
Accept the seller's friend request and join Grow a Garden 2.
The seller delivers the way their offer describes, for example by sending you a gift pack.
Check your balance in the bottom-left corner, then confirm the order.
delivery.typical_time: Sellers on DropMarket quote about 15 minutes while they're online.

support_topic.heading: Can You Gift Sheckles in Grow a Garden 2?
paragraphs: Yes. Every Sheckle and Leaf pack in the Store has a gift version, so another player can buy one and send it to you.
Packs cost Robux, so the sender pays for them. You don't need to share anything but your username.

faq_extra.q: How do you get more Sheckles in Grow a Garden 2?
faq_extra.a: Sell crops and pets at the Sell Stand, and play with friends: each friend in your server adds 10%, up to a 70% boost.

faq_extra.q: What are Leaves in Grow a Garden 2?
faq_extra.a: Leaves are the Fall Harvest event currency. You earn them by selling crops and pets in the Fall Harvest world, or buy them for Robux.
